Ravi (CS): FYI MedAxis just confirmed three new squads will start sending traffic next month: Clinical Insights, Claims Automation, and Patient Portal. They're projecting a 4x increase in chat tokens and a ~10x jump in embeddings. We should assess onboarding runway + renewal risk (renewal in ~2 months).

Maya (AE): Do they want hosted first or go straight to Private/Dedicated?

Sanjay (MedAxis): Prefer hosted to start for quick launch, but Claims needs strict isolation and HSM-backed keying. Clinical Insights wants sub-100ms p95 for short assistant queries. Patient Portal will do nightly batch embed refreshes (~3.5M vectors/day).

Lucas (Infra): Sub-100ms p95 at 4x QPS? possible but depends on model and caching. For 3.5M vectors/day we should recommend reserved capacity for embeddings and longer batch windows to smooth costs. HSM + VPC ok but needs our private deployment checklist.

Ravi (CS): Current baseline: avg QPS 150, p95 380ms, embeddings ~120k/day. They gave forecast: avg QPS ~600, p95 target 90-100ms for clinician flows, embeddings ~3.5M/day.

Maya (AE): Sounds like a clear expansion signal. I'll open a renewal/expansion opportunity and loop Legal for DPA/KMS terms. Can we get a conservative monthly cost delta and a quick playbook for onboarding?

Lucas (Infra): I'll run a quick capacity calc and propose two options: (A) Hosted + reserved embeddings windows (cost-opt) or (B) Private deployment w/ dedicated pods (SLA + HSM). Need more detail on concurrency and context length.

Sanjay (MedAxis): Concurrency: clinician-assistant sessions typically 1-3 concurrent per clinician, contexts ~1.5k tokens. Claims automation will send large batched documents for embeddings.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-2074: "MedAxis expansion - capacity analysis, private-deploy checklist, DPA/KMS review" assigned to Lucas.

Ravi (CS): Can we set a mini enablement next Tue 11am ET with their infra + security? Also prepare a checklist: model recommendations for low-latency, suggested quantization profiles, batching guidance, VPC/KMS steps, and a cost delta table.

Maya (AE): I'll send calendar invite and start drafting opportunity notes. Sanjay, any timeline sensitivity?

Sanjay (MedAxis): We want Clinician and Claims in prod in 6 weeks if possible. Patient Portal can roll in after. Renewal decision may hinge on cost and data controls.

Lucas (Infra): Quick local embedding load test snippet that helped last time:
```python -c "import requests,json
for i in range(10):
  r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer $T'}, json={'model':'embed-xl', 'input':['doc']*5000})
  print(r.status_code, len(r.text))"```

Ravi (CS): Marking CS-2074 high priority. I'll capture notes in the ticket after the Tue sync. :spiral_calendar: :lock:
